messages:

To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 09:20:00 -0800
Subject: Resale documentation for invoice hold - Greenline Outfitters

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks for flagging the invoice hold. We pulled together the paperwork you requested and attached two documents: a Texas blanket resale certificate and a reseller letter for Washington. Can you confirm whether these will clear the January subscription invoices (INV-5512, INV-5513)?

A few notes about Greenline that might be helpful:
- Legal name: Greenline Outfitters LLC
- Billing / parent entity EIN: 27-3941562
- We operate multiple shipping addresses across TX and WA (listed on the TX form)

We tried to include a purchaser ID on the TX form but the PDF editor stripped a line; if you need a re-signed PDF we can resend this afternoon. Also let us know if you need additional state-specific language — WA has a different reseller letter policy.

Attached: TX_blanket_resale_signed.pdf (PDF), WA_reseller_letter.pdf (PDF)

Thanks,
Elena
Accounts Payable | Greenline Outfitters
accounts@greenline.com
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <epark@greenline.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Resale documentation for invoice hold - Greenline Outfitters

Elena — thanks for the fast reply and for sending the files. Looping in Ben (AR) and Marissa (Revenue Ops) so we can handle validation and invoice release. Quick clarifying items so we can process on our side: 

1) Please confirm the exact legal name you want on our customer record (Greenline Outfitters LLC vs Greenline Outfitters). They must match the TX certificate.
2) The TX blanket you sent is helpful but the purchaser tax ID/EIN field appears blank in the attached PDF. Can you reattach a signed copy that includes the EIN or purchaser sales tax ID?
3) For WA we typically need either a state reseller permit number or a reseller letter on company letterhead with an authorized signature. The PDF looks like a draft letter.
4) Confirm whether the exemption should apply to SaaS/subscription charges or only to tangible goods — some states treat software differently. If this is intended to cover our SaaS invoices, please state that on the certificate/letter or provide a short statement on letterhead.

Upload link (preferred): https://drive.redwood.com/share/greenline-exemption-pack
If you re-send via email, we can triage for partial release if TX is completed.

thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Senior Revenue Operations Associate
Redwood Inference

- EIN included on TX form: 27-3941562

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <epark@greenline.com>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Jan 2027 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Resale documentation for invoice hold - Greenline Outfitters

Elena — thanks for the updated files and for clarifying the scope. We reviewed the TX blanket (TX_blanket_resale_signed_v2.pdf) and it satisfies our requirements for the Texas sales tax exemption: purchaser legal name, EIN, signature, and covered addresses are present. We will release the following invoices immediately: INV-5512, INV-5513 (January subscription line items relating to TX shipments).

For Washington: the reseller letter is helpful, but our AR policy requires either a state reseller permit number or, in certain cases, a WA-issued registration ID. Since you noted the WA registration is pending, we'll keep WA-related invoices on hold until you can provide the WA permit number or an equivalent WA tax authority confirmation. We can re-run the clearance once you upload the permit.

Action items we will take now: 
- Release INV-5512, INV-5513 and apply any eligible credit for chargeback INV-5479 to your account (credit applied by EOD today).
- Mark the WA invoices as pending and send a reminder to your AP contact in two weeks if permit not provided.

If you want us to expedite WA earlier, please provide the permit number or an explicit WA exemption ruling from the Dept. of Revenue.

Thanks for moving quickly on this — appreciate the cooperation.

Regards,
Ben Carter
Accounts Receivable Manager
Redwood Inference
